title: Super Mario Land 2: 6 Golden Coins (USA, Europe)
source_path: roms/roms-to-patch/Super Mario Land 2 - 6 Golden Coins (USA, Europe).gb
strategy: S1-save-hook + boot restore + clear hook + MBC5 header conversion with 0x3000->0x2000 bank-write retargeting; journal in ROM bank 0x24 with an on-demand WRAM helper
current_issue: None. Life-loss reset root cause was fixed by moving all patch code to ROM bank 0x24 and copying only a small helper to WRAM 0xC100 on demand. Emulator tests pass, including a save after a real level load and a natural death/transition with a NOR-flash model. The normal build was tested on the HC007 cart.

save.checksum: sum of slot bytes 0x00..0x44 stored at slot+0x45
save.write_routine: 0x2934 (bank 0), hooked at 0x2862, 0x3147 and 9 banked call sites
save.delete_routine: bank 0x0C 0x4227, relocated to bank 0x24 0x4500 and hooked via JP 0x197B

hooks.boot_restore: bank 0x0C 0x4034 CALL -> 0x1AFF; boot code bank 0x24 0x4000; the bank-0 hook restores 0x0C
hooks.save_hook: all CALL 0x2934 sites -> CALL 0x1967; journal in bank 0x24 0x4800, WRAM helper copied to 0xC100; bank restored in bank 0
hooks.clear_hook: bank 0x0C 0x4227 -> JP 0x197B; relocated clear body at bank 0x24 0x4500
hooks.code_bank: bank 0x24 (0x90000): boot code 0x4000, clear body 0x4500, journal 0x4800, WRAM helper source 0x4C00
hooks.wram: helper copied to WRAM 0xC100 on demand; game WRAM 0xC100-0xC3FF backed up to SRAM 0xB600-0xB8FF (save) or 0xAD00-0xAFFF (boot) and restored
hooks.log_sector: chip 0x80000-0x8FFFF, bank 0x20, CPU 0x6000; appended 1 MiB image
hooks.mapper_note: MBC5 conversion needs the 22 MBC1 low-bank writes at 0x3000 retargeted to 0x2000; otherwise MBC5 treats 0x3000 as bank bit 8 and the world-map tiles are garbled. The game never writes 0x4000/0x6000.

open_questions: Optional: long-term wear and full-log erase after many save/delete cycles.

Re-run the emulator tests and IPS round-trip after any source/recipe change.
ips_note: The full patches include the 0xFF extension and reproduce the target SHA-1 exactly in any IPS patcher. The minimal patches need --pad-to 0x100000 --pad-byte 0xFF or a flasher that fills new banks with erased flash.
hardware: pass on HC007 cart: boot, life-loss save without reset, power-cycle/load, delete
